messages:
caroline: heads-up — planning a scheduled KMS key rotation that will replace cosign signing key for base images. Need to coordinate SBOM/provenance, runtime verification, and RBAC updates. ETA Thurs 9pm PT.

raj: +1. Important: rotation will break existing image signatures until we re-sign. Do we have a canary flow?

mike: we can rebuild minimal base images in canary pool and re-sign via CI using KMS plugin. plan: 1) generate new key in KMS, 2) update cosign workflow to use new key ARN, 3) re-sign images, 4) promote.

anya: what about attestation metadata and SBOMs in our registry? Will checksum IDs change?

raj: SBOM content will be identical but cosign payload (signature) changes. We should attach new attestation with predicate stating 're-signed during key rotation'. Keep old attestations for audit.

mike: sample cosign commands:
```
cosign generate-key-pair --kms aws-kms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd
cosign sign --key k8s://serviceaccount/image-signer image:sha256:...
cosign verify --key k8s://serviceaccount/image-signer image:sha256:...
```
CI job will pull from KMS via role assumption.

caroline: RBAC: who needs write perms to the signing key? I'd like to restrict to a single ephemeral service account and sec ops admins.

raj: agree. Proposed IAM policy snippet:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Sign", "kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd",
  "Condition": {"ForAnyValue:StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/role": "image-signer"}}
}
```
Also add audit logs to S3 with object ACL restricted.

anya: runtime verification — do we need to update node agents? They verify signatures at pod pull time.

mike: runtime agent supports key rotation via trust bundle. We'll add new public key to bundle before rotation, so verification accepts both old and new keys for a 24h overlap. That avoids pull-time failures.

sec-bot: :rotating_light: Automated alert: orphaned images found with mismatched attestation during dry-run: registry.prod/repo/base@sha256:aa11 — tagging for triage.

raj: ok sec-bot triage: assign to @mike for rebuild, @anya for runtime agent rollout, @caroline for communication to infra teams.

mike: starting canary rebuild now. I'll post logs in #eng-infra when done.

caroline: timeline: canary rebuild + verification by EOD, full rotation at 9pm PT if canary green. Notify support and update status page.

ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered: rebuild-base-provenance-canary #257 — logs: https://ci.internal/257 

anya: one more note — we should include a short runbook step in the signer's playbook: how to revoke/roll-forward and how to fallback to previous key if verification fails.

raj: agree — include rollback steps and a query to search audit logs for any failed verifies during the window. Also tag all images re-signed with metadata key:rotation=2367890123 for traceability. :thumbsup:
